checks.renderedDesign: All seven views, 35 screenshots: 0 FAIL, 0 REFLEX, 0 WARN.
checks.browser: Seven views and native review drawer at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440, 1920px in light/dark; no page overflow, clipped controls or uncaught errors.
interactions: Real finance values and pending decisions from finance-workbench simulation
Inbox search, no-results reset, severity filters and sort
Native drawer focus containment, Escape, backdrop dismissal and opener/heading focus restoration

finishReview.detail: Ship. Reviewed full inbox, all five drawer records at 320×568, light/dark and seven phone views. Additional functional test caught and fixed focus loss after a response removed its queue row.

preservation.data: Existing Convex queries, scenario hash, gateway semantics and WebMCP tools retained

preservation.ledger: Latest 60 entries as before, with full chain count and explicit limit; all trial balance accounts remain available

limitations: Browser tests used local Convex and deterministic simulation, not a deployed environment.
Figma is a native editable reference snapshot, not an automatic two-way sync with React.
The journal query still returns the most recent 60 entries; CSV exports the currently filtered records.
